tn_midterm_cram.text: Midterms are tomorrow and your notes are a crime scene. The clock does not care.

outcomes.aced: Caffeine and panic deliver. You ace it and feel like a legend.
outcomes.zombie: You fall asleep on question four. The exam wins.
outcomes.unseen: Nobody notices. Your conscience files a formal complaint.
outcomes.caught: The teacher stands right behind you. You get a zero and a detention slip.

tn_science_fair.text: The science fair is next week. Your volcano idea has been done by every kid since the dawn of volcanoes.

outcomes.first_prize: Your project wins first prize. A judge shakes your hand like you matter.
outcomes.fiasco: The project fails loudly and spectacularly. Some of it ends up in your hair.

tn_teacher_feud.text: Your history teacher has decided you are the problem. Every class, she says your name like a sigh.

tn_join_band.text: The music teacher is recruiting for the school band. Your only qualification is that you once owned a recorder.

tn_late_again.text: You overslept again and strolled in twenty minutes late. The hall monitor has a clipboard and zero mercy.

outcomes.let_off: She waves you through with an eye roll. You feel invincible.
outcomes.detention_anyway: Your charm lands about as well as a paper plane. Detention.

tn_group_project.text: Group project time. Your partners are one genius, one ghost, and one kid who only draws sharks.

tn_final_exams.text: Final exams arrive like a storm you saw coming and ignored. Everything depends on the next three hours.

outcomes.great_luck: Somehow your gut knew every answer. You walk out glowing.
outcomes.average: It goes fine. Fine is a very respectable word.
outcomes.disaster: Your gut was wrong about nearly everything. Including lunch.

tn_debate_club.text: Someone dares you to join the debate club. They promise you will be good at winning arguments, which is your best skill.

outcomes.champion: You win your first tournament with a speech about cafeteria pizza. The crowd roars.
outcomes.crushed: You get crushed by a kid who talks like a lawyer. You learn a lot.

tn_skip_class.text: Your friends are skipping last period to sit by the creek. Math class suddenly sounds like prison.

outcomes.fun_day: The creek is lovely and nobody notices you left. Freedom tastes like gas station chips.
outcomes.busted: The vice principal is waiting at the gate. Detention for a week.

tn_college_talk.text: The guidance counselor wants to discuss your future. She slides a pamphlet across the desk that says 'Dream Big' in a font that does not.

tn_detention_hallway.text: You are stuck in detention again, staring at a clock that refuses to move. The kid next to you offers half a sandwich and a brilliant escape plan.

outcomes.clean_getaway: You slip out through the window and become a minor legend.
outcomes.caught_again: Your chair squeaks. The teacher adds another week to your sentence.

tn_new_friend.text: A new kid stands at the lunch table holding a tray and the look of someone expecting rejection.

tn_house_party.text: A classmate's parents are out of town and the invitation is circulating like a rumor. Everyone you know will be there.

outcomes.legend: You are a hit. Someone says your name with admiration, which is new.
outcomes.awkward: You spend three hours holding one cup and discussing the sofa.
outcomes.cops: The neighbors call the police. You run home in a stranger's jacket.

tn_hot_pepper_dare.text: Someone has brought the hottest pepper they could find and a crowd has formed. Eating it is clearly the only way to be a person.

outcomes.hero: You finish it, cry for ten minutes, and are carried through the hallway like a champion.
outcomes.regret: Your face goes through five colors. The nurse gives you milk and judgment.

tn_secret_spilled.text: You find out your best friend told everyone the secret you swore never to repeat. The hallway is suddenly full of knowing smiles.

tn_embarrassing_video.text: Someone filmed you tripping over absolutely nothing and posted the video. It has more views than anything you have ever done.

outcomes.deleted: The video comes down. You are a hero in your own story.
outcomes.backfired: Your outrage becomes the second video.

tn_band_gig.text: Your band gets offered a slot at the school talent night. You have three songs, two of which are the same song.

outcomes.crowd_loves: The crowd cheers. A kid yells your band's name wrong, but it counts.
outcomes.crickets: Polite clapping. Someone coughs in a sentimental key.

tn_popular_table.text: Now that you're popular, the cool table has a chair for you. Your old friends wave from a distance like survivors on a raft.

tn_sleepover.text: You're invited to a sleepover where the main activities are scary stories, pizza, and a loud argument over who gets the couch.

tn_rebel_haircut.text: You stare at the mirror and decide your hair is boring. A box of neon dye sits in the bathroom like a dare.

outcomes.stunning: You look like a dangerous cartoon. People stare, and you love it.
outcomes.swamp: It turns the color of pond water. Your relatives stop making eye contact.

tn_mom_curfew.text: {{name}} announces a new curfew: home by nine. She says it like a verdict.

outcomes.got_away: You get home at midnight. {{name}} is asleep and the secret is yours.
outcomes.grounded: {{name}} is waiting in the dark kitchen. You are grounded until further notice.

tn_dad_lessons.text: {{name}} decides it's time to teach you to drive. He grips the dashboard before you've even turned the key.

outcomes.thrill: You hit a hundred in an empty lot. {{name}} makes a noise like a kettle.
outcomes.bump: You tap a cone, then a lamppost. {{name}} stops speaking for the rest of the lesson.

tn_sibling_borrow.text: You discover {{name}} has been wearing your clothes without asking. Your favorite shirt returns with a mystery stain.

tn_mom_phone.text: {{name}} picks up your phone and starts reading your messages. She treats your friend group like a mystery novel.

tn_dad_report_card.text: {{name}} finds your report card and studies it in silence, like a treasure map leading to disappointment.

tn_sibling_secret.text: {{name}} confides a big secret and makes you swear not to tell. You can already feel it burning a hole in your pocket.

outcomes.they_help: Your parents handle it kindly. {{name}} is furious for exactly one week.
outcomes.bad_idea: It goes badly. {{name}} refers to you only as 'the traitor'.

tn_mom_birthday.text: {{name}}'s birthday is tomorrow and you have not planned anything. A card feels cheap, a cake feels risky.

tn_dad_chores.text: {{name}} hands you a list titled 'Weekend Duties'. It is two pages long and includes the garage.

tn_first_crush.text: You notice someone in your class who laughs at all the wrong jokes. You think about them far more than any normal person should.

tn_ask_out.text: After weeks of practicing in the mirror, you finally have a chance to ask someone out. Your heart is making loud, unhelpful noises.

outcomes.yes: They say yes and smile. You float home without touching the ground.
outcomes.no: They let you down gently, which somehow hurts more.
outcomes.yes_text: They reply 'sure!' with a tiny star. You read it twelve times.
outcomes.left_on_read: Read at 4:12 p.m. No reply. You consider moving to another country.

tn_first_date.text: Your first official date is at the park, with snacks you both pretend not to be nervous about.

outcomes.sweet: They laugh at your jokes, even the bad ones. It's the nicest afternoon in months.
outcomes.awkward_date: You spill soda on them within five minutes. They claim it's fine. It is not fine.

tn_dance_invite.text: The school dance is coming. Your friends say you must go, and also that you must bring somebody, and also that you should hurry.

tn_breakup.text: The text arrives without warning: 'we need to talk.' It is never about how well things are going.

outcomes.make_up: You talk it through and decide to stay together. The panic fades into relief.
outcomes.final_end: Your speech is moving, but they're already gone.

tn_love_note.text: Someone has slipped a folded note into your locker. It contains a heart and the words 'you're okay I guess.' You decode it for three days.

tn_love_triangle.text: Two people you like have both asked you to the same event. Your afternoon turns into a soap opera with a vending machine.

outcomes.smooth: You choose, and everyone is surprisingly mature about it. Suspicious.
outcomes.drama: Both of them find out you hesitated. A cafeteria argument breaks out.

tn_prom.text: Prom night arrives. Everyone is in rented formal wear and fake confidence.

outcomes.magic: The music is cheesy and the moment is perfect.
outcomes.stepped_on: You step on their foot twice. They laugh anyway, which is generous.

tn_allowance_raise.text: You decide it is time for an allowance raise. You prepare a presentation with charts. The charts are drawn in marker.

outcomes.approved: They approve a modest raise and applaud your effort. The charts get framed.
outcomes.denied: They give you ten dollars for 'creativity' and send you to your room.

tn_first_job.text: You apply for your first real job. Every posting wants experience, and the only way to get experience is a job.

outcomes.hired_burger: You're hired to flip burgers and wear a paper hat. The grill is cruel but the pay is real.
outcomes.rejected_burger: The manager says they will keep your resume on file. The file is a trash can.
outcomes.hired_store: You get a job stacking shelves and learn more about cereal than anyone should.
outcomes.rejected_store: They ask for experience you do not have. Not even a little.

tn_boss_raise.text: Your boss notices you've been showing up on time, which is shockingly rare. She hints at a possible raise.

outcomes.raise_given: She smiles and bumps your pay. You immediately spend it in your head.
outcomes.raise_denied: She says 'budget' in a tragic voice. You return to the grill with dignity.

tn_lawn_mowing.text: A neighbor offers to pay you to mow their lawn. The lawn is huge and so is the mower.

outcomes.good_enough: Close enough. The neighbor pays you anyway.
outcomes.flowerbed: You mow the flowerbed. The neighbor won't speak of it.

tn_birthday_cash.text: Birthday cash arrives from relatives in an envelope that smells like perfume. It's eighty dollars, a small fortune in teenage currency.

tn_shoplift_dare.text: Your friends dare you to swipe a candy bar from the corner store. The cashier is busy with a crossword.

outcomes.get_away: You stroll out unnoticed. The candy tastes like guilt.
outcomes.caught_stealing: The cashier catches you and calls your school. A very long lecture follows.

tn_graffiti.text: A blank concrete wall behind the gym is begging for art. You have a can of spray paint and an opinion.

outcomes.masterpiece: Your mural gets nicknamed 'The Blob.' You are secretly proud.
outcomes.arrested_painter: A security guard spots you mid-stroke. You scrub the wall for hours.

tn_fake_id.text: Someone sells fake IDs out of a locker. The photo looks like a hostage from a bad dream.

outcomes.works: The cashier barely glances at it. You feel powerful and also a little sick.
outcomes.confiscated: Your ID gets confiscated, and the principal makes a speech.

tn_mailbox_prank.text: A friend suggests whacking mailboxes with a bat on the walk home. It's hilarious until it is not.

outcomes.clean_escape: You hit one, the bat flies, and nobody sees. Your heart pounds like a drum.
outcomes.witness: A porch light flips on. You spend the weekend repairing mailboxes.

tn_growth_spurt.text: Overnight you grow three inches and lose all coordination. Doorframes now seem hostile.

tn_sports_injury.text: During gym class, you sprint for the ball and the ground hits you first. Your ankle makes a noise like a snapped pencil.

outcomes.fine: It was just a sprain. You limp with dignity.
outcomes.worse: It was not fine. The doctor says the word 'crutches' with joy.

tn_sleep_debt.text: Between homework, scrolling, and existential thoughts, you have survived on four hours of sleep for a week. Your eyes look like raisins.

tn_driving_test.text: The driving test day arrives. The examiner holds a clipboard and looks like she has seen things.

outcomes.passed: You pass with a perfect parallel park. The examiner almost smiles.
outcomes.failed: You roll through a stop sign and take out a cone. Better luck next time.
outcomes.passed_later: Extra practice pays off. You pass, a little bored of parking.
outcomes.failed_later: Even with practice, the cone remains your enemy.

tn_joyride.text: Your friend dares you to take the car out at night and floor it on the empty back road. The speedometer needle quivers with anticipation.

outcomes.thrill_ride: You hit a hundred, scream with joy, and ease off before anything goes wrong.
outcomes.ticket: Blue lights flash in the mirror. The ticket is the worst souvenir.
outcomes.crash: You take the curve a little too fast. The night goes silent, and so does your story.
